questions.prompt: Which approach best applies android components variant api?
options: Use public variant callbacks and Provider-backed per-variant artifacts with isolated outputs.
questions.answer: Use public variant callbacks and Provider-backed per-variant artifacts with isolated outputs.
questions.explanation: The correct approach preserves Gradle’s lazy model, explicit data flow, variant correctness, functional evidence and operability.

questions.prompt: beforeVariants and onVariants are interchangeable points for disabling a variant.
questions.explanation: Writing every variant’s generated file to the same build/generated/config directory creates races and cross-variant contamination.

questions.prompt: Why must generated output include the variant identity?
questions.answer: Multiple variants may build together; isolated paths prevent overwrites, races and incorrect cache reuse.
questions.explanation: The answer names the model property that makes the build behaviour predictable rather than relying on incidental script order.
